pages.title: Setting Pages
pages.text:
This page is set down its middle ("anchor": "center"), its lines centred ("alignment": "center").

->*A paragraph can centre itself too.*<-

->And one can sit at the right.

pages.title: Justified
pages.text: With "alignment": "justify", every line of a paragraph but its last fills the width, the room shared out between its words a pixel at a time, so the edges stay straight on both sides. [Links](entry:basics/first_steps) still work word by word.

elements.title: Flip
elements.text: Pages are set one element under another. When one doesn't fit, its overflow decides: flow runs it on over the next pages, keep moves it whole to the next page, flip keeps it in a box and pages its text in place, and auto keeps it whole when it fits on a page of its own and flips it when even that isn't enough. This text is long on purpose, so it can't fit beside the card above it: use the clasps under it, or the mouse wheel over it, to read on. The recipe after it stays on this spread instead of being pushed away.

pages.title: Left and Right
pages.text: This card sits at the left ("alignment": "left"), its title at the right ("title_alignment": "right").
